::: {.contact-panel}

## Got something to share? {.contact-section-title}

::: {.share-panel}

We encourage members to **share resources, opportunities, events, questions and ideas directly with the community**.

For informal discussions, announcements and broader community engagement, post to the **LinkedIn group**.

For technical discussions, resources, code and other material relevant to practicing stock assessment scientists, contribute through our **GitHub repository**.

::: {.share-actions}

[Go to LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/groups/14536824/){.contact-platform-button target="_blank"}

[Go to GitHub](https://github.com/StockAssessmentCOP/StockAssessmentCOP){.contact-platform-button target="_blank"}

:::
